business: SEGMENT: personal injury law, Kansas City
prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Kansas City Missouri for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t credibly name a single “best” lawyer — that depends on your case details, budget, whether you want a trial lawyer, and personal fit — but I can help you find one and evaluate candidates. Here’s a focused plan and what to look for when choosing a Kansas City, MO personal injury lawyer for a car-accident case.

Where to search quickly
- Missouri Bar lawyer search: https://www.mobar.org  
- Kansas City Bar Association referral: https://www.kcbar.org  
- National directories with ratings and client reviews: SuperLawyers (superlawyers.com), Martindale-Hubbell (martindale.com), Avvo (avvo.com), Best Lawyers (bestlawyers.com)

Key things to prefer
- Focused experience in car-accident/personal-injury law (not general practice).  
- Trial experience and willingness to go to court if needed.  
- Proven results: settlement and verdicts (ask for examples with similar facts).  
- Good client reviews and peer ratings (AV Preeminent / Super Lawyers are useful signals).  
- Contingency-fee practice (most PI lawyers work this way) and clear fee structure.  
- Clear communication: who handles the case day-to-day, typical response time.

Questions to ask in the free consultation
1. How many car-accident cases have you handled? How many in KC area?  
2. What percentage of your cases settle vs go to trial?  
3. Can you give examples of settlements/verdicts for similar injuries?  
4. Who will handle my case day-to-day — you or a paralegal/associate?  
5. What is your contingency fee and who pays expenses if we lose?  
6. How will medical bills/liens be handled?  
7. What timeline should I expect?  
8. How often will you update me and how do you prefer to communicate?  
9. Do you have references from former clients?  
10. Are you licensed in Missouri and in good standing?

Red flags
- Guarantees of a specific settlement amount.  
- Reluctance to put fee or communication terms in writing.  
- Poor online reviews describing unresponsiveness or missed deadlines.  
- No trial experience if your case likely needs litigation.

Next steps I can do for you
- If you give your ZIP code and any important details (serious injuries, uninsured motorist issue, disputes about fault, whether you want a trial lawyer), I can suggest a short list of well-rated Kansas City firms and provide sample questions tailored to your situation.  
- I can also help you evaluate attorneys you’ve already found (compare fees, experience, and answers to the questions above).

Would you like me to suggest a short list of Kansas City firms based on public ratings, or do you want help preparing for consultations?
